Hi Sofia —

Thanks again for the time earlier today. Quick recap from our discovery call and proposed next steps:

Recap / priorities you mentioned:
- Productionize an LLM-based summarization pipeline for clinical notes (latency target ~200ms per request, 95th percentile)
- Throughput expectations: ~800 requests/min during business hours, burst to 2k/min
- Data residency & encryption: patient data must stay in our US region; KMS/HSM required for key management
- Auditability: detailed request/response logs for a 90-day retention window
- Cost sensitivity: prefer recommendations that lower per-token unit cost while keeping quality

Next step: Technical deep dive (60-90 minutes) with your ML + infra teams so we can align on architecture, performance targets, and integration plan. Proposed agenda (attached as PDF):
- Introductions + goals (5-10m)
- Current architecture review (15-20m)
- Inference performance & SLOs (20-25m)
- Security, data residency, and compliance (15-20m)
- Integration plan, rollout, and runbook (10-15m)
- Q&A & next steps (10m)

Suggested time slots next week (all PT):
- Tue Apr 18 — 09:00-10:30
- Wed Apr 19 — 13:00-14:30
- Thu Apr 20 — 11:00-12:30

Redwood attendees we plan to bring:
- Marissa Cole — Enterprise AE (me)
- Camila Reyes — Solutions Engineer (deep-dive lead)
- Dylan Brooks — Infra / Serving Runtime Engineer

Please confirm preferred slot and any additional Acme attendees (ML lead, infra, security). I attached the draft agenda (Acme_Tech_Deep_Dive_Agenda.pdf) and a short pre-call checklist to help us prepare.

If you prefer, we can make this a 90-minute session to give more time for architecture discussion — happy to adjust.

Thanks,
Marissa
